description: Small, manually authored development/evaluation set for validating the TruthLens V2 first vertical slice end-to-end. NOT a world-level benchmark. NOT used to claim any global accuracy figure. Each fixture carries its own small synthetic evidence corpus (clearly not real scraped articles) so the full pipeline can be run deterministically offline.
